selectionRule: Matrix/environment annotation JSON designSystem === apple, or details.inventory-scope.config.designSystem === apple; case title is not used to classify design.
decision: Scoped Apple PNG review complete; old narrow failures and loading-video review remain pending. No full acceptance or baseline approval.
appearanceMapping: For the five-image interactive cases, image order follows the native source loop over the scene's public data-appearance controls: primary, tonal, outlined, text, elevated; per-appearance geometry attachments identify the same five controls.

observedGeometry.corners: Stable rounded Apple Web corners through hover, focus, pressed and toggle states; no macOS/private-material or native-SF parity claim. The repository documents 6px; borderRadius was not independently recorded in this run's geometry attachments.
observedGeometry.alignment: Labels remain aligned within the five action surfaces; hover and pressed feedback does not visibly move text or corners.
observedGeometry.boundaries: Primary/tonal/outlined/text/elevated hierarchies remain distinguishable in light and dark. Focus rings are complete and separate from adjacent actions; selected outlined actions invert their surface.

observations.detail: Both 320px old-source Apple failure images visibly clip danger actions and the long full-width label on the right; the native overflow assertion failed. Host-side minmax track changes are outside this candidate. These images are not accepted or converted into a pass.

This review checks the repository's independent Apple Web geometry, surfaces and states. Linux browser images are not evidence of matching a particular macOS release, private material, Liquid Glass or native system font rendering.

pending: Recapture both narrow configurations from the corrected source; the old two failures are not approved.

Human loading video/temporal review belongs to the root task. Ten natural loading PNGs were viewed, and native motion observations show progress, but a still frame cannot prove continuity of every appearance.
This candidate supplies Chromium only; Firefox/WebKit acceptance is not inferred.
Touch PNGs show the variants at s. Invisible hit layers and trusted tap behavior use the native assertions; no full five-size/five-appearance touch matrix is inferred from these two images.
No nested Provider, iframe, Shadow DOM, nonce propagation or configuration-preserved-draft evidence is present in this candidate's five source files.

Selected/unselected intentionally excludes Text under the documented ordinary-action scope; legacy Text+isSelected, actual href anchor behavior and every compatibility combination are not visually accepted here.
200% covers two true visible viewport captures per mode at the demo's s size, not every size or a full-page/pinch-zoom claim.
No pixel baseline, verified coverage or lifecycle update.
